# Imedica

> Imedica is decision-training software for Canadian paramedics, built by Ashavid Inc. in Ontario: short emergency scenarios scored against physician-written rules aligned to the Ontario ALS and BLS Patient Care Standards.

Imedica is for paramedic services (training leads, medical directors) and for paramedics and paramedic students. Scenarios are written and reviewed by physicians. Clinical content cites published standards and guidelines; see the Sources page. Imedica is a training tool, not a clinical decision-support device, and doesn't replace a service's medical directives.

## Product

- [Product](https://www.imedica.tech/product): what a scenario is and how it's scored
- [How it works](https://www.imedica.tech/how-it-works): authoring, running, scoring and debrief
- [For services](https://www.imedica.tech/for-services): what EMS services get, and how a pilot runs
- [Security](https://www.imedica.tech/security) and [PIPEDA](https://www.imedica.tech/pipeda): privacy and data handling under Canadian law
- [Sources and references](https://www.imedica.tech/sources): the clinical standards and datasets our content is built on

## Field Notes (blog)

- [Field Notes](https://www.imedica.tech/blog): case breakdowns, protocols and training articles for Canadian paramedics
